instrument_title_fr: Décret exécutif modifiant la consistance et les limites territoriales des communes de Hassi Messaoud et Hassi Ben Abdellah
notes: Decree 06-256 Article 1 was visually checked on both official JO49/2006 page images: French printed p.4 / PDF zero-based index 3 and Arabic printed p.4 / PDF zero-based index 3. The Arabic source locality label is وادي المرعى. Article 1 integrates Oued El Meraâ, formerly attached to Hassi Ben Abdellah, into the territory of Hassi Messaoud. This is a locality-parent transfer, not a register-code assertion. Do not conflate it with Decree 05-127/2005 Article 6, which earlier relocated the Hassi Messaoud chief-lieu seat to Oued El Meraâ while the place was inside Hassi Ben Abdellah territory.
